name: Wildcaster
description:
Magic doesn't come to them clean. Every spell they reach for drags something else along: somebody else's spell, from somebody else's art, a monster's bite, or the spell itself bent into a shape they never asked for. They have learned to aim it, roughly.

Cast and gamble: your spells sometimes come out as a random spell from any other class or as a wild spell found nowhere else, change form on the way out (a beam, a burst, a trap, or back at you), and late on surge on their own every turn. Spell Fever goes further: for a few turns your attacks won't keep their shape at all. Every cast builds Brimming; pace yourself or at ten it backlashes. Wild magic loves a lucky strike: critical hits set it off and hit harder. Scales with [SMT] and [PSI].

Inspired by the Wild Magic skill of Compleat Essential Skills (a Dungeons of Dredmor mod by Essence) and by the wild magic of D&D's sorcerers and Baldur's Gate II's Wild Mage.

effects.name: Brimming
effects.description: Wild magic piling up behind your teeth. It drains away if you give it a few turns; at ten it all comes out at once, and rarely the way you'd like.

options.name: Backlash: the spell eats your stamina
Backlash... the other way: it sings

effects.name: Fizzled
effects.description: The magic slips through your fingers: your spells hit softer for a while.

effects.name: Spell-Shy
effects.description: The backlash left you open and rattled.

effects.name: Unbound
effects.description: For once the wild magic went your way. Make the most of it.

effects.name: Spell Fever
effects.description: Your attacks won't hold their shape. Each one shows in its tooltip what it has turned into; casting it turns it into something else. Every cast feeds your Brimming.

modifies.name: a new form
modifies.summary: may come out a new way

effects.name: Fever Pitch
effects.description: The fever has you by the throat: your attacks land harder.

effects.name: Wild Edge
effects.description: With this much wild magic in you, every lucky strike lands like a thunderclap: more critical hits, and they hit harder.

effects.name: Lucky Pull
effects.description: You've pulled on your luck to open the fight. It will want paying back: when it runs out, your Brimming jumps.

effects.name: Shrunk
effects.description: Wild magic has made them much smaller: weak blows, and everything hurts more.

effects.name: Swollen
effects.description: Wild magic has made them much bigger: heavy blows, but a very easy target.

effects.name: Spilled Luck
effects.description: Somebody's luck is all over them. Their next few blows are likely to land true.

effects.name: Glassy
effects.description: Brittle for a moment. Everything hurts more.

effects.name: Golden Touch
effects.description: A dragon's blessing, landed on whoever was nearest: harder blows, and a bright shine that's easy to aim at.

newAbility.name: Wild Blood
newAbility.description: Every spell you cast, from any of your arts, builds Brimming, and now and then comes out as somebody else's spell aimed at the same foe, or as a wild spell, one of the strange ones that exist only in wild magic.

newAbility.name: Erratic Bolt
newAbility.description: A bolt of whatever comes to hand: fire, frost, current, rot or raw thought. You find out when it lands.

perk.name: Double-Barrelled
perk.description: Sometimes it's two things at once.

newAbility.name: Borrowed Spell
newAbility.description: Reach past your own art into someone else's and throw whatever you grab at the target.

newAbility.name: Spell Fever
newAbility.description: Stop holding your spells to their shape. For five turns every attack you aim, from any of your arts, can come out a new way: laid as a trap, lobbed as a grenade, carried by a minion that bursts into it, or blown out of you in every direction as a dearer, weaker nova. It can also gain a behavior, lose one or turn to another element. Its tooltip shows what it has become, and casting it rerolls it. Skills from the original game keep their shape.

perk.name: Fever Pitch
perk.description: It comes back sooner, and your attacks hit a quarter harder while it burns.

newAbility.name: Unmoored Ground
newAbility.description: Cut a patch of deck loose from any one art. For a few turns, anyone standing in it may be hit by any spell at all.

newAbility.name: Stray Magic
newAbility.description: The wild magic doesn't wait for you to cast any more. Striking, killing, getting hit, slipping a blow or landing a critical hit can all shake a borrowed spell loose at whoever was involved. And when your Brimming drains away, you keep a little stamina from it.

newAbility.name: Cascade of Spells
newAbility.description: Let the wild magic all out at one target: two borrowed spells, and one more for every two Brimming you pour in (up to four in all). It drains the Brimming it uses.

newAbility.name: Unruly Casting
newAbility.description:
A quarter of your attack spells change shape as they leave you: a burst over everything near the target, a beam through a whole line, a split onto other foes, a swerve onto someone else, a trap sunk into the deck where you aimed, or, now and then, the whole spell turned back on you.
Holding five or more Brimming, your casts also throw borrowed spells more often and give you Wild Edge (more and harder critical hits). Each fight opens with a Lucky Pull of critical chance that leaves you Brimming when it runs out.

newAbility.name: Riot of Aether
newAbility.description:
You no longer cast so much as leak. Every turn of a fight a Loose Spell may spin off you toward a foe and then wander the deck on its own for a few turns, two tiles a turn. On each tile it may go off on whoever is on or beside it, friend, foe or you: raw energy, a stray curse, a monster's attack, somebody else's spell, a wild spell, or an echo of a boss's attack, from Doctor Cerberus's Annihilation to Zahndethus's mending. The echoes grow with your [PSI] and your Crit.
Now and then a blast goes off all around you, and sometimes the magic does something to you instead, for good or ill. Critical hits set off a surge half the time, and that can be an echo too, even one that lands on you.

options.name: an echo of a boss's attack

wildSpells.name: Changed Places
wildSpells.say: you and your target wake up in each other's boots.

wildSpells.name: Second Helping
wildSpells.say: your last spell decides it wasn't finished.

wildSpells.name: Stolen Minute
wildSpells.say: a minute that belonged to someone else drops into your hands.

wildSpells.name: Coin Toss
wildSpells.say: heads it mends, tails it bites.

wildSpells.name: Sudden Winter
wildSpells.say: the air forgets what warm was.

wildSpells.name: Hot Floor
wildSpells.say: the deck remembers being a star.

wildSpells.name: Wandering Door
wildSpells.say: a door opens under them and lets out somewhere else.

wildSpells.name: Spectrum Spill
wildSpells.say: every colour at once, none of them politely.

wildSpells.name: Shrinking Feeling
wildSpells.say: someone nearby is suddenly a good deal smaller.

wildSpells.name: Growth Spurt
wildSpells.say: someone nearby no longer fits their clothes.

wildSpells.name: Luck Spill
wildSpells.say: good fortune hits the deck and everyone slips on it.

wildSpells.name: Glass Moment
wildSpells.say: for a moment everyone here is made of something brittle.

wildSpells.name: Postponed Spell
wildSpells.say: it will happen. Just not yet.

wildSpells.name: Wellspring
wildSpells.say: something kind leaks through, and it doesn't check sides.

wildSpells.name: Held Tongue
wildSpells.say: every word in the room goes missing.

wildSpells.name: The Horror
wildSpells.say: something that should not be here pushes through.
